faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Kalyani Assistant Registrar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Registrar post at IIIT Kalyani is 18 September 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Registrar position in the IIIT Kalyani recruitment drive. This is a contractual government job opportunity in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIIT Kalyani Assistant Registrar recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 250/-, and for SC/ST candidates, it is Rs. 200/-. Candidates belonging to the PwBD category are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Registrar position at IIIT Kalyani is 45 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms, if specified in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Assistant Registrar position at IIIT Kalyani?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Registrar post will receive a salary of Rs. 89,760.00 per month. This is a competitive salary for a contractual government position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent with an excellent academic record. Desirable qualifications include an MBA and relevant experience in specific administrative areas.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIIT Kalyani Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Registrar position at IIIT Kalyani includes a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIIT Kalyani Assistant Registrar recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIIT Kalyani. The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading documents, and paying the application fee before 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Assistant Registrar position is Kalyani, West Bengal, with Pincode 741235. IIIT Kalyani is located in the state of West Bengal.
